{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cocktail-length wrap dress, v-neckline, fitted waist, flowing skirt to just below the knee, vivid emerald green (#0B8F5A), lightweight crepe with a satin finish

Strappy block-heel sandals, open toe, 7 cm heel, metallic gold (#C9A227), smooth leather, comfortable for walking on grass

Small structured clutch, top-handle, gold-toned (#D4AF37) with a subtle sheen, satin-lined metallic leather

Statement drop earrings, sculptural teardrop shape, polished gold (#D4AF37), brass with gold plating

Thin cuff bracelet, open back, polished gold (#D4AF37), brass with gold plating

Why this outfit works: The saturated emerald dress is a bold choice that makes you stand out in a crowd of pastels and neutrals, while still staying clear of white and avoiding anything that competes with the bride. The wrap cut and lightweight crepe stay cool and comfortable for an outdoor ceremony at 16:00 in August, and the length is smart enough for the restaurant that follows. Block heels keep you steady on grass and are easy to wear through a long evening. Gold accents add polish and warmth, so the look reads confident and celebratory without being overdone."}
